content.title: The Birth of the Messiah: A Commentary on the Infancy Narratives in the Gospels of Matthew and Luke
content.author: Raymond E. Brown (Garden City: Doubleday, 1977; updated edn 1993)
content.note: A Roman Catholic critical scholar's commentary on Matthew 1–2 and Luke 1–2. On the virginal conception it judges that the historical evidence leaves the question unresolved, while affirming it as church teaching.
